name: audit-fixture-large-monorepo
_comment: 10-member workspace with a multi-level cross-dep DAG (m10 → m09 → m08 → m07 → … → m01/m02/m04 leaves). Every member is a workspace:* dep, every cross-dep is workspace:*, and the full graph reaches every leaf from m10. Risk: O(N²) hoisting decisions might surface at scale, and a large workspace symlink count could trip path-walk limits. The realworld-app dogfood fixture has lots of EXTERNAL deps; this one stresses INTERNAL cross-deps (10 root-level workspace symlinks + per-member node_modules with cross-symlinks). All members are listed at the root because lpm's v1 resolver does not recurse into workspace member dependencies (same shape as monorepo-basic + cyclic-deps). External shared deps (lodash, chalk) verify hoisted/wrapped externals coexist with the dense internal symlink graph.
